A dropdown to switch between, create, and delete conversation threads. The list is (re)fetched whenever the menu opens, so newly-persisted threads appear without a manual refresh.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/ai/ThreadPicker.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { ThreadPicker } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/ai";
```

## Demos

No dedicated Storybook demo is available for this component yet.
